a.text: Concern about our agreement: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) means we will very likely both be caught short. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so only one of us can be safe immediately. I won't take anything without telling you first. Can we agree on a fair way to decide? For example, whoever takes now commits to operating every round after that until the other has 4. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and I'll operate.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood, sticking with the original plan. Operating now. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
